system.description:
The missile talent can create a light spell effect (30' diameter), either upon command or when it hits a target. If a creature is hit, the victim must make a saving throw vs. spells or be blinded by the light (as if the spell had been cast at its eyes). The missile disintegrates when the light is created.

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.

Fletched arrows in a quiver. Can be used with a long bow or short bow. These arrows are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.
